title: Update 16.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2020 Release Wave 1
summary: Update 16.2 for Business Central 2020 Release Wave 1 introduces data migration from on-premises versions, improved telemetry, authentication updates, and web client enhancements. Use this page to learn about new features, hotfixes, and upgrade information for this release.
features: Data migration from Business Central 14.x on-premises to 15.x online
Error telemetry updates in Application Insights
URL parameter to hide web client header
Modern authentication for Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Sales
